purpose: Track the upstream increment after the 2026-10-06 historical snapshot by AG99 capability and plugin-compatibility impact, not by source-code identity.

policy.goal: Improve AG99 while preserving plugin compatibility.
policy.version_alignment: Use the AstrBot version and public plugin contracts as compatibility anchors; do not bump the version only to mirror commit history.
policy.plugin_version_contract: metadata.yaml astrbot_version is evaluated as a PEP 440 range by astrbot/core/star/star_manager.py.
policy.frontend_deployment: Frontend changes require a production build and synchronization to data/dist after validation.

commits.title: feat(dashboard): scoped path-token auth for plugin views and complete the views rename (#10415)
commits.compatibility: Plugin view authentication and the Pages-to-Views naming contract were adapted to the local FastAPI/dashboard layout; canonical view tokens are preserved.

commits.title: fix: avoid blocking audio format probes (#10055)
commits.compatibility: Preserves async runtime responsiveness without changing media adapter contracts.

commits.title: fix(provider): replace retired gemini-embedding-exp-03-07 default with gemini-embedding-001 (#10393)
commits.compatibility: Keeps the default embedding provider usable after the upstream model retirement.

commits.title: perf(dashboard): reduce first-screen load (lazy-load VAD/Monaco/i18n/ApexCharts, gzip responses) (#10413)
commits.compatibility: Lazy loading was integrated without replacing AG99's configuration and plugin UI boundaries. Static response compression was already covered by the earlier local adaptation 3bf85f8ad.

commits.title: feat: remember the last opened tab on the Data & Logs page (#10251)
commits.compatibility: Useful UI behavior, but it is not required for plugin compatibility and the current AG99 dashboard does not use the same DataPage route structure. Revisit only as a separate UI enhancement.

commits.title: fix: match command group names as whole words (#10372)
commits.compatibility: Preserves command-group matching semantics for platform plugins and avoids partial-name collisions.

commits.title: fix(dify): handle CRLF event separators in streaming responses (#10392)
commits.compatibility: Keeps Dify-compatible streaming parsing tolerant of Windows line endings.

commits.title: feat(dashboard): preview staged chat input images in ChatUI (#10376)
commits.compatibility: Improves ChatUI attachment feedback without changing the message material contract.

commits.title: docs: sync Lark/Feishu guide with current capabilities and permissions (#10400)
commits.compatibility: Documentation-only synchronization; no runtime or plugin contract change identified.

commits.title: fix: preserve Slack code block and quote text (#10380)
commits.compatibility: Preserves Slack rich-text content delivered to plugins and Core.

commits.title: fix(telegram): match bot mentions case-insensitively (#10399)
commits.compatibility: Keeps Telegram command and mention handling stable for plugins across case variants.
